query:
SELECT LEFT(body, 500)
        FROM logs
        WHERE received_at > $1 AND received_at <= $2
          AND ($3 = '' OR service_name = $3)
          AND severity >= $4
          AND ($5 = '' OR body ~* $5)
          AND ($6 = '' OR attributes->>$6 = $7)
          AND org_id = $8
        ORDER BY received_at DESC
        LIMIT 1
